audit.v_particiones_worm.definicion:
SELECT c.oid::regclass::text AS particion,
    l.desde,
    l.hasta,
    ( SELECT max(w.id) AS max
           FROM audit.worm_exports w
          WHERE w.particion = c.oid::regclass::text) AS ultimo_export_id
   FROM pg_inherits i
     JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = i.inhrelid
     CROSS JOIN LATERAL audit.limites_particion(c.oid::regclass) l(desde, hasta)
  WHERE l.hasta IS NOT NULL AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM pg_class p
             JOIN pg_namespace pn ON pn.oid = p.relnamespace
          WHERE p.oid = i.inhparent AND pn.nspname = 'audit'::name AND p.relname = 'audit_events'::name))
  ORDER BY l.desde;

cm.v_catalogo_grafo.definicion:
SELECT e.tipo AS edge_type,
    e.es_dirigida,
    e.descripcion AS edge_descripcion,
    array_agg(DISTINCT n_src.kind ORDER BY n_src.kind) AS src_kinds_validos,
    array_agg(DISTINCT n_dst.kind ORDER BY n_dst.kind) AS dst_kinds_validos
   FROM cm.edge_types e
     CROSS JOIN cm.node_types n_src
     CROSS JOIN cm.node_types n_dst
  GROUP BY e.tipo, e.es_dirigida, e.descripcion;

    COALESCE(ix.indisready, false) AS listo,
    (( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM vec.hnsw_hojas(c.tabla::regclass) h(h)
          WHERE NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                   FROM pg_index pi
                     JOIN pg_class pc ON pc.oid = pi.indexrelid
                     JOIN pg_am am ON am.oid = pc.relam AND am.amname = 'hnsw'::name
                  WHERE pi.indrelid = h.h AND pi.indisvalid))))::integer AS particiones_sin_indice,
    (( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM pg_index pi2
             JOIN pg_class pc2 ON pc2.oid = pi2.indexrelid
          WHERE (pi2.indrelid = c.tabla::regclass::oid OR (pi2.indrelid IN ( SELECT h.h
                   FROM vec.hnsw_hojas(c.tabla::regclass) h(h)))) AND NOT pi2.indisvalid))::integer AS indices_invalidos,
    pg_size_pretty(
        CASE
            WHEN idx.relkind = 'i'::"char" THEN pg_relation_size(idx.oid::regclass)::numeric
            ELSE COALESCE(( SELECT sum(pg_relation_size(t.relid)) AS sum
               FROM pg_partition_tree(idx.oid::regclass) t(relid, parentrelid, isleaf, level)
              WHERE t.isleaf), 0::numeric)
        END) AS tamano
   FROM vec.hnsw_catalogo c
     LEFT JOIN pg_class idx ON idx.oid = to_regclass((split_part(c.tabla, '.'::text, 1) || '.'::text) || c.indice)::oid
     LEFT JOIN pg_index ix ON ix.indexrelid = idx.oid
  WHERE c.activo;
